shared_tail.surface: عمرو بن عبد الله بن وهب أبو سليمان النخعي

notes: Two taḥwīl branches: «ح» separates them, and «قالوا حدثنا عمرو» is the convergence, so the names from Amr onward are the shared tail (rule 3)
Three or more routes: the rule-based reading is flagged uncertain in the archive; the reading follows the text's own «ح» and «قالوا»
The Prophet ends the chain; Anas is the last link
